ValidationRule.description: Status can only changed to Suspended or Expired from Approved Status.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( TEXT( PRIORVALUE( CLA_Status__c ) ) = 'Approved' , TEXT( CLA_Status__c ) <> 'Suspended' , TEXT( CLA_Status__c ) <> 'Expired', TEXT( CLA_Status__c ) <> 'Approved')
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Status can only changed to Suspended or Expired from Approved Status.
